entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please say 'agent' at any time to speak with a representative.
Agent.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi... uh, yes. I need to... I think I need to return something? It's a helmet. I'm a bit lost on how to do it.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Oh, um, yes, I think so. It's VF-789012.
Thank you. Let me just pull that up... Okay, I see the Urban Commuter Helmet, delivered about two months ago. Is that the one?
Yes, that's it. It's all so confusing.
I understand. To make sure I handle this correctly for you, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
I... I don't know. It's just the color. It didn't look like that on the website. The box is still unopened, I haven't even touched it. The website had so many options... Can't you just help me?
Of course, I'm here to help. It sounds like the color just wasn't quite right for you. Let me quickly check the return eligibility for you.
Okay...

Alright, I have good news. I see here that your item was delivered 67 days ago, which is well within our 90-day return policy for a standard item like this helmet. We can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Oh! Really? So I can just send it back? It's that easy?

It is. Your safety and satisfaction are our top priorities. I've just emailed a prepaid return label to the address on file. All you need to do is print it, stick it on the box, and drop it at a post office. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed.
Wow. Okay. Thank you so much, Sarah. You've been a great help.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can do for you today?
No, that's everything. Thank you!
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
